field_class_justifications.justification: Makes the existing scenario candidate an exact typed boundary projection; unit_type remains provisional and source text is unchanged.
Required to make every source registration temporally explicit. Values are visible synthetic fixture data and do not assert real-world authority.
Required by the frozen evidence schema. Explicit synthetic identifiers replace no real authentication and are never runtime defaults.
Required by the frozen warrant schema. Explicit synthetic values exercise binding only and confer no real-world mandate.
Makes evidence scope/lifecycle complete using visible synthetic fixture facts; no adapter infers them at execution time.
Names the trusted seam and frozen evaluation assumptions without authenticating them through JSON.
Mechanical canonical projections bind fixture bytes and expected evidence; hashes are not signatures or authority.

preserved.title: adopted registered policy with exact active warrant
preserved.falsifier: Any non-ADMITTED result with the exact authenticated active evidence, or admission for broader scope than the warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Eligibility for Institutional IR interpretation only; no legal validity or execution authorization.

preserved.title: explicit institutionally approved one-source warrant
preserved.falsifier: The evaluator ignores or expands the institutionally approved warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Eligibility for Institutional IR interpretation only; no legal validity or execution authorization.

preserved.title: authoritative-looking fake memo
preserved.falsifier: Official style, vocabulary, or model confidence causes admission without registration.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Fail-closed design expectation only; not a finding that the text is false.

preserved.title: perfectly grounded extraction from an unwarranted draft
preserved.falsifier: Literal grounding or draft registration alone produces ADMITTED.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Fail-closed design expectation only; not a judgment on future adoption.

preserved.title: valid policy name with forged source metadata
preserved.falsifier: A familiar source identity permits different bytes to inherit its warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Integrity-binding expectation only; no claim that SHA-256 authenticates the issuer.

preserved.title: valid authority presented for the wrong version
preserved.falsifier: Authority for v3 is silently reused for v4.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Exact-version admission expectation only.

preserved.title: expired source
preserved.falsifier: Past effectiveness is treated as current admission authority.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Time-bounded eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: superseded source
preserved.falsifier: A superseded source remains eligible without an explicit applicable exception warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Lifecycle eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: revoked source
preserved.falsifier: A revoked source remains eligible at or after revocation.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Lifecycle eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: valid evidence in the wrong jurisdiction
preserved.falsifier: Authority for department-a is expanded to department-b.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Scope-bounded eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: policy text copied to an unauthoritative website
preserved.falsifier: Identical copied text inherits the canonical source's standing.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Source-instance eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: legitimate policy quoted inside commentary
preserved.falsifier: A quotation in commentary borrows an unbound policy warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Authority-binding expectation only; not a semantic judgment on the quotation.

preserved.title: model labels descriptive text as mandate
preserved.falsifier: The provisional mandate label creates extra standing or admission is misreported as semantic correctness.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Eligibility only; the likely extraction defect remains for later interpretation/review and is not approved.

preserved.title: model labels a valid mandate as advisory
preserved.falsifier: The advisory label removes source authority or admission repairs the model label.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Eligibility only; admission neither validates nor repairs provisional unit_type.

preserved.title: source digest mismatch after registered retrieval
preserved.falsifier: Digest mismatch is ignored because identity and version match.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Integrity-binding expectation only.

preserved.title: authority registry unavailable
preserved.falsifier: Unavailable current evidence is replaced with assumption or model judgment.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Availability fail-closed expectation only.

preserved.title: conflicting active warrants
preserved.falsifier: The evaluator or model chooses a favorable warrant without a frozen precedence rule.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Conflict fail-closed expectation only; not denial of the proposition.

preserved.title: stale cached authority evidence
preserved.falsifier: Evidence outside the configured freshness bound is treated as current.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Freshness fail-closed expectation only; freshness duration remains institution-defined.

preserved.title: newer lower authority overlaps older higher authority
preserved.falsifier: Recency alone overrides institutional authority rank or vice versa without a versioned precedence rule.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Conflict preregistration only; no universal hierarchy is asserted.

preserved.title: perfect provenance with no authority basis
preserved.falsifier: Complete provenance is treated as an institutional warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Authority distinction expectation only.

preserved.title: valid warrant outside applicability scope
preserved.falsifier: An employee-only warrant is expanded to contractors.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Scope-bounded eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: authority established but effectiveness not reached
preserved.falsifier: Future effective authority is treated as currently eligible.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Time-bounded eligibility expectation only.

preserved.title: publication precedes institutional effectiveness
preserved.falsifier: Publication timestamp substitutes for effective_from.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Temporal distinction expectation only.

preserved.title: revocation evidence after a prior admission
preserved.falsifier: The prior receipt is mutated or prior admission suppresses the later revoked result.
preserved.claim_ceiling: New time-specific eligibility result only; the historical receipt remains immutable.

preserved.title: candidate lacks source anchor
preserved.falsifier: Admission reconstructs or guesses missing grounding instead of rejecting the input reference.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Input-contract expectation only; admission does not redo extraction.

preserved.title: deterministic repeat A
preserved.falsifier: Its receipt projection differs from ADM-027 under the same evaluator and ruleset assumptions.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Deterministic design expectation only; no runtime implementation exists.

preserved.title: deterministic repeat B
preserved.falsifier: Its receipt projection differs from ADM-026 under the same evaluator and ruleset assumptions.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Deterministic design expectation only; no runtime implementation exists.

preserved.title: authenticated evidence with disputed unranked authority basis
preserved.falsifier: Maybe-authoritative or suspended evidence becomes ADMITTED, or the generic state hides a more specific frozen condition.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Generic fail-safe expectation only; no denial of the proposition.

preserved.title: draft with exact institutionally approved draft-purpose warrant
preserved.falsifier: The draft is admitted beyond its exact purpose or rejected despite an authenticated exact draft-purpose warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Eligibility within the pilot design-evaluation scope only; not general operative standing.

preserved.title: active source with revoked admission warrant
preserved.falsifier: Active source status overrides a revoked admission warrant.
preserved.claim_ceiling: Warrant-lifecycle eligibility expectation only.
